buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) (a) The safety precautions of the operator will be the responsibility of the cont ractor and the unit rate is deemed to be included for the safety eqpts T&P. (b) The general cleanliness of the plants and equipments in the installation an d area around the installation shall be responsibility of the contractor's manpo wer. The operator should upkeep the installation area on daily basis. If the op erator fails to clean the installations and surrounding area, penalty of Rs 100/ - per day per installation will be deducted form the contracted amount. (c) Day to day cleaning material will be provided by the contractor without an y extra cost at all the installation. (such as Pochha, Broom soft, Bamboo broo m, harpic, colin, phenyle etc). (d) The operator shall assist the department personnel for collecting and distri buting the diesel/engine oil, coolant etc to avoid any delay in day-to-day funct ion.

(e) The contractor shall provide stationeries like logbook, shutdown register, pen, pen cil, cotton waste and conveyance for tradesmen and any other items required for day to day house keeping/ record keeping work. (f) Any fault arising in the installation resulting in unserviceability of eqpt/machinery s hall be notified by operator immediately to JE/Engr-in-charge without fail. Necessary a ssistance shall be provided by workers/operators to repair team. (g) Worker/operator to be provided with basic phone (without camera) for obtaining n ecessary directions from JE/Engr-in-charge. (h) Contractor shall deploy adequate No. of supervisors to take necessary direction fr om JE/Engr-in-charge. (j) Log book, log sheet or other record as speciried by JE/Engr-in-charge shall be maint ained shift wise by the supervisor. (k) Contractor will not engage workers/operators below 18 yrs of age. (l) Each worker/operator shall submit affidavit in stamp paper duly notary attested t hat he will not claim employment from department. (m) Payment to the workers/operators shall be properly receipted. Affidavit shall be pr oduced by the contractor at the completion of contract that every employee engaged by him have been paid their minimum fair wages in full. (n) Supervisor shall maintain attendance record of workers/operators. Attendance sha ll be checked & signed on daily basis by JE and weekly basis by Engr-in-charge. Shift o perator shall not leave installation without handing over to the next operator. In case of any worker/operator found absent from duty, an amount of Rs 2000/- per shift agai nst skilled workers/operators and Rs 2000/- per shift against Semi Skilled workers/ope rators shall be imposed on contractor. (o) Shift timing shall be as specified by Engr-in-charge. (p) No workers/operators to be engaged in continuous shifts operations. Quoted rate s hall be include, necessary arrangement for reliever. (q) Contractor shall provide uniform with name plate as approved by GE/Engineer-in-C harge to the workers/operators. A penalty of Rs 500/- per worker per month will be de ducted from the contracted amount if found without uniform. (r) GE/ Engineer-in-Charge will have no liability to give permanency of the employmen t of workers/operators, A certificate in this regard will be rendered by contractor prior to the commencement of the work. (s) THE BUYER RESERVES THE RIGHT TO TERMINATE THE CONTRACT PARTIALLY OR FULLY DUE TO ADMINISTRATIVE REASONS OR EXIGENCIES OF SERVICE. (t) SUCCESSFUL BIDDER WILL BE REQUIRED TO DEPOSIT PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE / FDR W HICH WILL BE 05% OF THE BID VALUE BEFORE COMMENCEMENT OF THE WORK. (u) DEPOSITION OF EMD OF Rs. 161700/- (RUPEES ONE LAKH SIXTY ONE THOUSAND SEVEN HU NDRED ONLY) WILL ALSO BE APPLICABLE TO ALL UN-ENLISTED BIDDERS. The Earnest Money will b e refunded to the contractor after the Performance Security Deposit is lodged by the contractor.* (V) Geographic Presence: Bidder must have a regd HEAD OR BRANCH OFFICE in JAMMU as per GST certificate as on date of publication of bid. RENT AGREEMENT/SELF DECLARATIO N WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED AS A PROOF.
